name: DuplicateFinder
description: Detects duplicate movies, TV episodes, and music tracks.
overview: Scans your Jellyfin library for duplicate movies, TV episodes, and music tracks using provider IDs (TMDb, IMDB, MusicBrainz) and fuzzy title+year matching. Presents a report highlighting the best copy to keep based on resolution, codec, and bitrate.

versions.changelog: Alternate-version detection (S01E01.mkv + S01E01.mp4), TV episode multi-episode range and part-split awareness, cross-series false-positive prevention, unit tests.
